faits.fait: iSanté is the in-house brand of Cetip, a subsidiary of Cegedim Assurances. Cetip also operates the SP Santé brand.
The tp-isante.fr site describes itself as a “third-party payment operator” (tiers payant: the patient pays nothing upfront, insurers pay the provider directly). iSanté is not a care network.
For an optician, contracting is done directly with iSanté. For this category, the form does not refer to the Inter-AMC association.
Without an iSanté agreement, the optician cannot use iSanté third-party payment.
The iSanté e-transmission number is unique and appears on third-party payment cards: 00733931.
With e-transmission, iSanté pays in three business days instead of seven, from receipt of the documents (article 3.2 of the agreement).

iSanté favors e-transmission as a single combined claim (DRE). Separate handling of mandatory insurance (AMO) and supplementary insurance (AMC) must be set up in the software, otherwise requests do not arrive.
The iSanté card shows the iSanté logo, the validity period and, in the column for each area of care, the coverage rate or the coverage request procedure to follow.
The list of active supplementary insurers is published on tp-isante.fr. It is updated each time a supplementary insurer opens or closes a segment.
Optical coverage requests are made on IsantePEC, opened from the tp-isante.fr area with the “Accéder au service” (Access the service) button.
For a request with a frame, the portal requires entering the frame on the first line, then the lenses.
The official coverage approval is printed as a PDF from the request, with the “Imprimer” (Print) button.
A coverage request cannot be deleted. It is canceled with “Annuler la PEC” (Cancel the coverage approval), by choosing a reason.

Some supplementary insurers activate a price filter, an optional service of iSanté third-party payment. It lets them refuse a quote or coverage approval whose price is considered “off-market”. It has been available in optical for several years.
The filter compares the requested price with the average price charged for the same product in a given geographic area. The optician can then adjust their price according to the grid.
Among iSanté clients that use this filter, savings amount to a little under 4% of lens spending: €7.15 million out of €181 million (press release of May 7, 2026).

conventionnement: On tp-isante.fr, open the contracting request form and choose the Opticien (Optician) category.
Enter the FINESS or Adeli identifier, the RPPS number, the company name, the SIRET number, the brand or group, the contact person, the software used and the bank details.

Upload the documents: bank details (RIB) in the store’s name and address, company registration extract (Kbis) less than 3 months old, Adeli certificate from the regional health agency (ARS), CPAM certificate, the manager’s ID, and the agreement signed using the template provided.
Accept the agreement and submit. An email confirms the request and explains how to create the account.
Create access to the secure area (“Je souhaite créer mon compte”, I want to create my account) with the FINESS or Adeli identifier, the company name, the postal code, an email address and a password.
